podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Yield on Demand: Burying Legacy Banking with Reid Cuming
podcasts.description: Today, we are opening the hood on the invisible infrastructure quietly reshaping global finance. For decades, the financial world has operated on fragmented rails, slow settlements, opaque intermediaries, and capital locked in static accounts earning next to nothing. A pittance, dare I say! But what if the underlying engine of money was open, instant, and directly connected to the owner? We are witnessing a seismic transition toward onchain liquidity, where yield, lending, and leverage are no longer distant back-office functions reserved for Wall Street institutions, they are becoming embeddable features for any app, bank, neobank, fintech, or platform on earth. Today’s conversation explores what happens when financial primitives become modular building blocks. We’re diving deep into the future of tokenized real-world assets, direct-to-owner finance, and how code is turning capital into a dynamic, programmable engine via APIs.
